name: Glames
source:
Rogles' top general. Glames may be a rape monster from The Dark World, but he sure does care for his troops. He is a fearless warrior, an honorable duelist, and a smart tactician. He hates to see them die and is seen as a hero to rape monsters everywhere. Wait, what?

Glames has a history with Cham. She used to be one of his soldiers and they fought side by side, until Cham quit to start a rebellion. They were once very close and Glames still has strong feelings for her.
